definitions.explanation: Exerting such great force, presence, or superiority that the other side cannot resist. Used for both physical dominance and psychological impact.

examples.japanese: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{強|つよ}さだった。
{相手|あいて}チームを{圧倒|あっとう}して{勝|か}った。
examples.english: We won by overwhelming the opposing team.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}の{迫力|はくりょく}に{圧倒|あっとう}されて{言葉|ことば}が{出|で}なかった。
examples.english: I was so overwhelmed by the power of the performance that I was speechless.

notes:
USAGE:
The derived adjective {圧倒的|あっとうてき} (overwhelming) is extremely common and often more frequent than the base form. The passive form {圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed) is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}: overwhelming (adjectival form)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{多数|たすう}: overwhelming majority
- ～に{圧倒|あっとう}される: to be overwhelmed by ~
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{勝利|しょうり}: overwhelming victory
